subject: planner: avoid to use `ScalarFunction.GetCtx` in some planner codes (#48794)
summary: Reviewed the diff vs first parent: changes are a context-threading refactor to avoid relying on `ScalarFunction.GetCtx` (planner/executor now pass `sessionctx.Context` explicitly into constant folding, column substitution, correlated-column substitution, and window-function constant extraction). Call sites consistently use plan/executor `SCtx()`/function ctx, and expression evaluation switches from `EvalWithInnerCtx` to `Eval(ctx)` accordingly. No Blocker/High correctness/semantic/session/plan-cache hazards found in the touched planner/executor/expression paths; later upstream history shows subsequent refactors but no revert/follow-up fix specifically indicating a critical issue here.
